_comment_pubkey: Leave empty on a fresh deployment — first run will route operators to /setup to claim ownership via any Nostr signer. Or set GRAIN_OWNER_PUBKEY (hex or npub) in the environment to claim declaratively at startup without the UI step.
_comment_version: version is overlaid at NIP-11 response time from the running build; the placeholder below is fine to leave as-is.
_comment_ui: Most string fields default to empty: name / description / banner / icon / contact / policy URLs are best edited via the /admin dashboard once the relay is running. The dashboard's Ops section fires the corresponding NIP-86 changerelay* methods.
